(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port keep in Event) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port metric out Snapshot) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block ShadowRenderer
        (port in in Receipt)
        (port out out Snapshot)
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block LocalRenderer
        (port evt in Event)
        (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
      (block EdgeBilling
        (port in in Command)
        (port emit out Receipt)
        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
      (block Pricing
        (port req in Request)
        (port out out Request)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block LiveIndex
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")
              (level
                (block EdgeCatalog :type "Store"
                  (port req in Request)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
            (block Uploader
              (port evt in Receipt)
              (port emit out Receipt)
              (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block ShadowQueue
                    (port out out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                  (block RemoteProfile
                    (port req in Snapshot)
                    (port out out Event)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))

                  (port evt in Request)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))

                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                  (block ShadowIndex :type "Process"
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                  (block RemoteScheduler
                    (port req in Request)
                    (port done out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                  (block LocalCache :type "Store"
                    (port evt in Snapshot)
                    (port out out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))))))
    (adjacent
      (block LiveAuth
        (port evt in Receipt)
        (implements Durable)
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block EdgeCache
        (port emit out Command)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (block EdgeIndex
            (port in in Event)
            (port done out Receipt)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block ShadowPlanner
                  (port in in Request)
                  (port emit out Receipt)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block LiveCatalog
                  (port evt in Snapshot)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                (block EdgeAuth
                  (port req in Receipt)
                  (port emit out Receipt)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block BatchAudit
                  (port out out Command)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))))
        (level
          (block Search
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block RetrySearch
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block LiveAudit
                  (port in in Request)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
              (block BatchMailer
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))

            (block BatchRouter
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))
      (block EdgeSync :type "Feature"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
    (block BatchAuth
      (port in in Command)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
  (level

      (sketch "Thin wrapper.")

          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))

      (block Session

      (block Mailer

        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block RetryLedger

              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block Metrics :type "Feature"
                    (port out out Snapshot)
